title: L’intégration nationale
through_line: Un village qui grandit : d’abord quelques cases, puis tout un pays qui vit ensemble.

blocks.vo_line: L’intégration nationale, c’est le mélange des cultures et des traditions.
blocks.shot: Several coloured ribbons of different patterns braiding together into one wide ribbon above a crowd of small figures.

blocks.vo_line: Au Cameroun, plus de deux cent cinquante ethnies vivent dans la paix.
blocks.shot: Many small colourful African houses of different styles on gentle hills, tiny people walking between them, warm sun.

blocks.vo_line: Les mariages entre ethnies rapprochent les familles.
blocks.shot: Two families in different traditional clothes joining hands around a happy couple, flowers in the air.

blocks.vo_line: La cohabitation et les affectations des travailleurs les rapprochent encore.
blocks.shot: Neighbouring houses side by side and a small bus arriving with a worker carrying a bag, friendly village street.
